<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<pos> pr. n. pl.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (Africa, Ἀφρική) 
<italic>Africa</italic>, esp. Northern A., the 
<italic>Africa Propria</italic> or 
<italic>Vera</italic> of the Romans.</definition>
<notes> Y. Shebi. III, 36
<sup>c</sup> bot. the Girgashite הלך לו לא' emigrated to Africa (Carthage). Ib. ‘a land like your own’ (II Kings XVIII, 32) זו א' that means A.; Lev. R. s. 17; Deut. R. s. 5.—Snh. 91
<sup>a</sup> אפריקיא (corr. acc.). Tam. 32
<sup>a</sup> sq. מדינת א'; (Lev. R. s. 27; Pesik. Shor p. 74
<sup>a</sup> קרטיגנא, v. חֹשֶׁךְ). Lam. R. to I, 5. דוכוס דאפריקא Duke (military governor) of A. (Egypt &c.).—Denom. אַפְרְקִיִּים, ch. אַפְרִיקָאֵי 
<italic>Africans</italic> (Negroes). Sabb. 31
<sup>a</sup>.—Targ. II Chr. XXI, 16.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="A02838">
<head-word>אַפְרָשָׁה, </head-word>
<head-word>הַפְרָשָׁה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (פָּרַשׁ) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>separation, setting apart for a sacred purpose</italic>, as the heave-offering (T’rumah, for the priest), or a sacrifice (Korban); also 
<italic>isolation on account of levitical uncleanness</italic>, or 
<italic>on acc.</italic></definition>
<notes>
<italic> of sacredness</italic>. Trnsf. 
<italic>the thing set apart, offering, gift</italic>. Y. Yoma I, beg. 38
<sup>a</sup>; Tosef. Parah III (II), 1 זה (הַ)אַפְרָשָׁתוֹ בטהרה וכ' (Babli Yoma 8
<sup>b</sup> פרישתו) the one is isolated for the purpose of purification (because of uncleanness), the other for sanctification (for the services of the Day of Atonement). Y. Dem. VII, 26
<sup>b</sup> bot. תלוי בה' depends on the act of setting apart. B. Kam. V, 7 הַפְרָשַׁת הר סיני the isolation of Mount Sinai prescribed as preparation for the giving of the Law (Ex. XIX, 13); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. אַפְרָשׁוֹת, הַפְרָשׁוֹת</plural-form>. Y. Shek. II, 46
<sup>d</sup> top שלש א' three kinds of sacred gifts.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>crossing the Ocean;</italic> cmp. פָּרַשׁ.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 6 הפרשת וכ'; Lev. R. s. 25 פָּרָשַׁת.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="A02841">

<sup>b</sup> bot. אי א' שיכפר וכ' I do not want the Day of Atonement to bring me forgiveness. Y. Yeb. XIII, beg. 13
<sup>b</sup> א' בנישואיך I am willing to marry thee. Num. R. s. 13 (alluding to Gen. III, 2</notes></sense>
<sense>
